pages.text: Coffee trees, blueberry bushes, and vanilla are cultivated plants. Cocoa, milk, sugar, fruit and wheat become the foundations of syrups, cream, dough, chocolate and desserts.

pages.title: Cultivated Crops
pages.text: Coffee trees and blueberry bushes grow on dirt, grass blocks, or farmland; vanilla seeds require farmland. Mature coffee and blueberry plants can be harvested without breaking them, and bone meal accelerates growth.
